geometry_strategy: Approved Rev29 fit envelope, body, beaded frame, and motifs preserved. Raised numbers are uniformly scaled and centered to drawer 1. Body facets are subdivided without changing their surfaces to improve the peppermint color boundary.

number_standard.rule: same height, depth, vertical center, and horizontal group center as drawer 1; two-digit numbers remain centered as a pair
